sql: WITH last_round AS (SELECT r.year,MAX(r.round) round FROM races r JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE r.year>=2001 GROUP BY r.year), points AS (SELECT r.year,ds.driver_id,ds.points FROM races r JOIN last_round lr ON r.year=lr.year AND r.round=lr.round JOIN driver_standings ds USING(race_id) WHERE ds.points>0), lowest AS (SELECT * FROM points p WHERE points=(SELECT MIN(x.points) FROM points x WHERE x.year=p.year)), team_seasons AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.year,l.driver_id,l.points,re.constructor_id FROM lowest l JOIN races r ON r.year=l.year JOIN results re ON re.race_id=r.race_id AND re.driver_id=l.driver_id), counts AS (SELECT constructor_id,COUNT(DISTINCT year) seasons FROM team_seasons GROUP BY constructor_id) SELECT ts.year,d.forename,d.surname,c.name,ts.points,SUM(re.points) points_with_team FROM team_seasons ts JOIN drivers d USING(driver_id) JOIN constructors c USING(constructor_id) JOIN races r ON r.year=ts.year JOIN results re ON re.race_id=r.race_id AND re.driver_id=ts.driver_id AND re.constructor_id=ts.constructor_id GROUP BY ts.year,ts.driver_id,ts.constructor_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ts.constructor_id)=1 AND SUM(re.points)=0 ORDER BY ts.year
